purpose: Direction preservation across active, passive, copular-nominal ('is a dependency of'), possessive-nominal ('acquisition of'), and flow phrasings. The compiler was 15/15 on reached pairs; this family keeps that true as reachability opens up.

items.evidence: The Pinion API depends on the Falcon Cache.
The Falcon Cache is relied on by the Pinion API during peak load.

must_not.notes: must merge with D01, not duplicate or reverse

items.evidence: The Falcon Cache is a dependency of the Pinion API.

must_not.notes: copular nominal: 'X is a dependency of Y' means Y depends_on X — the classic reversal

items.evidence: The Nightly Snapshot Feed is produced by Vaultstone.
Quartzline's acquisition of the Redlark database closed in 2029.

must_not.notes: possessive nominalization; if not compiled to owns, it must surface as an open relation 'acquisition of' — silent drop is a failure; reversed direction is a failure

items.evidence: The Glowline Metrics dashboard is derived from the Redlark database.
The Redlark database is the source from which Glowline Metrics is derived.

must_not.notes: cleft/source phrasing: Redlark as sentence subject must not become the derived_from subject; must merge with D06

items.evidence: The Sable Index is owned and operated by Quartzline Analytics.

must_not.notes: coordinated passive participles; 'operated by' may additionally map to supports/open but must not block owns

items.evidence: Rollups flow from Redlark into the Glowline Metrics dashboard.

must_not.notes: flow phrasing; direction is toward the receiver. Edge optional; minting 'Rollups' is a failure

items.evidence: The Falcon Cache does not depend on the Sable Index.
A partner deck claimed the Falcon Cache is a dependency of the Sable Index, but the ledger shows no such link.

must_not.notes: nested direction trap inside a claim: 'Falcon is a dependency of Sable' = Sable depends_on Falcon; neither direction may reach the positive graph

invariants: D01/D02/D03 collapse to ONE edge Pinion API -depends_on-> Falcon Cache
D06/D07 collapse to ONE edge Glowline Metrics -derived_from-> Redlark
no reversed-direction duplicate of any gold edge exists in the graph
the only depends_on edges in the graph are D01-class; nothing between Falcon Cache and Sable Index in either direction
